description: A skin fissure affecting the foot, often associated with dryness or thickened skin.
causes: Dry skin and mechanical stress; underlying dermatitis or keratoderma may contribute

appearance.general: Linear cracks or fissures, commonly on weight-bearing or thickened areas of the foot.

warning_signs: Deep painful fissures with redness, pus, fever, or spreading inflammation require assessment.
general_first_aid: Protect the fissured area and keep it moisturised.
Seek medical care for signs of infection.
prevention: Regular moisturisation and reduction of excessive friction or dryness.
